name: PARTIAL_QUANTITY
formal_condition: 0_i < O_i < I_i on a valid ordered quantitative dimension

name: PARTIAL_PARTY_COVERAGE
formal_condition: Observed affected-party set is a non-empty proper subset of intended party set

name: PARTIAL_OBLIGATION_DISCHARGE
formal_condition: At least one but not all required obligations reach intended state
example: principal obligation discharged but fee obligation remains open

name: PARTIAL_STATE_PROPAGATION
formal_condition: Observed consequential mutation graph is a proper subgraph of intended propagation graph
example: internal ledger updated but downstream settlement state not propagated

name: PARTIAL_RESOURCE_COVERAGE
formal_condition: At least one but not all intended financial resources receive the intended mutation
example: one account updated while another required account remains unchanged

name: MIXED_OR_CONTRADICTORY
example: cash moved correctly but ownership registered to wrong party
